WITH paid AS (
  -- one row per paying user: their Q3 2025 payments that were not refunded, added up
  SELECT s.user_id, SUM(p.amount_eur) AS revenue
  FROM payments AS p
  JOIN subscriptions AS s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE p.paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND p.paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND p.refunded = false
  GROUP BY s.user_id
),
touches AS (
  -- one row per session of a paying user up to the moment of signing up, with its channel
  SELECT pd.user_id, se.session_id, se.session_start,
         CASE WHEN se.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL THEN ch.channel_name
              WHEN se.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'organic'
              WHEN se.utm_medium = 'referral' THEN 'referral'
              ELSE 'direct' END AS channel
  FROM paid AS pd
  JOIN signups AS g ON g.user_id = pd.user_id
  JOIN sessions AS se ON se.visitor_id = g.visitor_id AND se.session_start <= g.signup_ts
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.utm_campaign = se.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
),
path_length AS (
  -- one row per paying user with a touch: how many touches the path has
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS n_touches
  FROM touches
  GROUP BY user_id
),
credits AS (
  -- one row per touch, with the revenue it earns under each model, then one row per paying user with no touch
  SELECT t.channel,
         CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM touches AS t2
           WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id
             AND (t2.session_start > t.session_start
                  OR (t2.session_start = t.session_start AND t2.session_id > t.session_id))
         ) THEN pd.revenue ELSE 0 END AS last_click,
         CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM touches AS t2
           WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id
             AND (t2.session_start < t.session_start
                  OR (t2.session_start = t.session_start AND t2.session_id < t.session_id))
         ) THEN pd.revenue ELSE 0 END AS first_click,
         pd.revenue / pl.n_touches AS linear
  FROM touches AS t
  JOIN paid AS pd ON pd.user_id = t.user_id
  JOIN path_length AS pl ON pl.user_id = t.user_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'unattributed', pd.revenue, pd.revenue, pd.revenue
  FROM paid AS pd
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM touches AS t WHERE t.user_id = pd.user_id)
),
all_channels AS (
  -- one row per channel, plus one for unattributed
  SELECT channel_name AS channel FROM channels
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'unattributed'
),
by_channel AS (
  -- one row per channel that earned credit under at least one model
  SELECT channel, SUM(last_click) AS last_click, SUM(first_click) AS first_click, SUM(linear) AS linear
  FROM credits
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT a.channel,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.last_click, 0), 2) AS last_click_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.first_click, 0), 2) AS first_click_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.linear, 0), 2) AS linear_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.first_click, 0) - COALESCE(b.last_click, 0), 2) AS first_minus_last_revenue
FROM all_channels AS a
LEFT JOIN by_channel AS b ON b.channel = a.channel
ORDER BY last_click_revenue DESC, a.channel

         CASE WHEN se.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL THEN ch.channel_name
              WHEN se.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'organic'
              WHEN se.utm_medium = 'referral' THEN 'referral'
              ELSE 'direct' END AS channel
  FROM paid AS pd
  JOIN signups AS g ON g.user_id = pd.user_id
  JOIN sessions AS se ON se.visitor_id = g.visitor_id AND se.session_start <= g.signup_ts
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.utm_campaign = se.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
),
path_ends AS (
  -- one row per paying user with a touch: when the first and the last touch started, and how many touches there are
  SELECT user_id, MIN(session_start) AS first_start, MAX(session_start) AS last_start, COUNT(*) AS n_touches
  FROM touches
  GROUP BY user_id
),
first_touch AS (
  -- one row per paying user with a touch: the first touch, the lower session_id on a tie
  SELECT t.user_id, MIN(t.session_id) AS session_id
  FROM touches AS t
  JOIN path_ends AS pe ON pe.user_id = t.user_id AND t.session_start = pe.first_start
  GROUP BY t.user_id
),
last_touch AS (
  -- one row per paying user with a touch: the last touch, the higher session_id on a tie
  SELECT t.user_id, MAX(t.session_id) AS session_id
  FROM touches AS t
  JOIN path_ends AS pe ON pe.user_id = t.user_id AND t.session_start = pe.last_start
  GROUP BY t.user_id
),
credits AS (
  -- one row per paying user and touch, or one unattributed row for a paying user with no touch
  SELECT COALESCE(t.channel, 'unattributed') AS channel,
         CASE WHEN t.session_id IS NULL OR t.session_id = lt.session_id THEN pd.revenue ELSE 0 END AS last_click,
         CASE WHEN t.session_id IS NULL OR t.session_id = ft.session_id THEN pd.revenue ELSE 0 END AS first_click,
         pd.revenue / COALESCE(pe.n_touches, 1) AS linear
  FROM paid AS pd
  LEFT JOIN touches AS t ON t.user_id = pd.user_id
  LEFT JOIN path_ends AS pe ON pe.user_id = pd.user_id
  LEFT JOIN first_touch AS ft ON ft.user_id = pd.user_id
  LEFT JOIN last_touch AS lt ON lt.user_id = pd.user_id
),
all_channels AS (
  -- one row per channel, plus one for unattributed
  SELECT channel_name AS channel FROM channels
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'unattributed'
),
by_channel AS (
  -- one row per channel that earned credit under at least one model
  SELECT channel, SUM(last_click) AS last_click, SUM(first_click) AS first_click, SUM(linear) AS linear
  FROM credits
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT a.channel,

    WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id

  )

  -- one row per channel with a last touch

       ROUND(COALESCE(l.revenue, 0), 2) AS last_click_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(f.revenue, 0), 2) AS first_click_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(n.revenue, 0), 2) AS linear_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(f.revenue, 0) - COALESCE(l.revenue, 0), 2) AS first_minus_last_revenue
FROM channels AS ch
LEFT JOIN last_rev AS l ON l.channel = ch.channel_name
LEFT JOIN first_rev AS f ON f.channel = ch.channel_name

FROM no_touch
ORDER BY last_click_revenue DESC, channel

  SELECT channel, SUM(last_click) AS last_click, SUM(first_click) AS first_click, SUM(linear) AS linear
  FROM credits
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT a.channel,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.last_click, 0), 2) AS last_click_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.first_click, 0), 2) AS first_click_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.linear, 0), 2) AS linear_revenue,
       ROUND(b.first_click - b.last_click, 2) AS first_minus_last_revenue
FROM all_channels AS a
LEFT JOIN by_channel AS b ON b.channel = a.channel
ORDER BY last_click_revenue DESC, a.channel

WITH paid AS (
  -- one row per paying user: their Q3 2025 payments that were not refunded, added up
  SELECT s.user_id, SUM(p.amount_eur) AS revenue
  FROM payments AS p
  JOIN subscriptions AS s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE p.paid_at BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
    AND p.refunded = false
  GROUP BY s.user_id
),
touches AS (
  -- one row per session of a paying user up to the moment of signing up, with its channel
  SELECT pd.user_id, se.session_id, se.session_start,
         CASE WHEN se.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL THEN ch.channel_name
              WHEN se.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'organic'
              WHEN se.utm_medium = 'referral' THEN 'referral'
              ELSE 'direct' END AS channel
  FROM paid AS pd
  JOIN signups AS g ON g.user_id = pd.user_id
  JOIN sessions AS se ON se.visitor_id = g.visitor_id AND se.session_start <= g.signup_ts
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.utm_campaign = se.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
),
path_length AS (
  -- one row per paying user with a touch: how many touches the path has
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS n_touches
  FROM touches
  GROUP BY user_id
),
credits AS (
  -- one row per touch, with the revenue it earns under each model, then one row per paying user with no touch
  SELECT t.channel,
         CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM touches AS t2
           WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id
             AND (t2.session_start > t.session_start
                  OR (t2.session_start = t.session_start AND t2.session_id > t.session_id))
         ) THEN pd.revenue ELSE 0 END AS last_click,
         CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM touches AS t2
           WHERE t2.user_id = t.user_id
             AND (t2.session_start < t.session_start
                  OR (t2.session_start = t.session_start AND t2.session_id < t.session_id))
         ) THEN pd.revenue ELSE 0 END AS first_click,
         pd.revenue / pl.n_touches AS linear
  FROM touches AS t
  JOIN paid AS pd ON pd.user_id = t.user_id
  JOIN path_length AS pl ON pl.user_id = t.user_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'unattributed', pd.revenue, pd.revenue, pd.revenue
  FROM paid AS pd
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM touches AS t WHERE t.user_id = pd.user_id)
),
all_channels AS (
  -- one row per channel, plus one for unattributed
  SELECT channel_name AS channel FROM channels
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'unattributed'
),
by_channel AS (
  -- one row per channel that earned credit under at least one model
  SELECT channel, SUM(last_click) AS last_click, SUM(first_click) AS first_click, SUM(linear) AS linear
  FROM credits
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT a.channel,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.last_click, 0), 2) AS last_click_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.first_click, 0), 2) AS first_click_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.linear, 0), 2) AS linear_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.first_click, 0) - COALESCE(b.last_click, 0), 2) AS first_minus_last_revenue
FROM all_channels AS a
LEFT JOIN by_channel AS b ON b.channel = a.channel
ORDER BY last_click_revenue DESC, a.channel

WITH rev AS (
  SELECT sb.user_id, SUM(CAST(p.amount_eur AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS amt
  FROM payments p JOIN subscriptions sb ON sb.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE p.paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND p.paid_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND NOT p.refunded
  GROUP BY sb.user_id
),
pu AS (
  SELECT r.user_id, r.amt, sg.visitor_id, sg.signup_ts FROM rev r JOIN signups sg ON sg.user_id = r.user_id
),
t AS (
  SELECT pu.user_id, s.session_id, s.session_start,
    CASE WHEN s.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL THEN ch.channel_name
         WHEN s.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'organic'
         WHEN s.utm_medium = 'referral' THEN 'referral'
         WHEN s.utm_source IS NULL AND s.utm_medium IS NULL THEN 'direct'
    END AS channel
  FROM pu JOIN sessions s ON s.visitor_id = pu.visitor_id AND s.session_start <= pu.signup_ts
  LEFT JOIN campaigns c ON c.utm_campaign = s.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
),
agg AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS n,
    arg_max(channel, (session_start, session_id)) AS last_ch,
    arg_min(channel, (session_start, session_id)) AS first_ch
  FROM t GROUP BY user_id
),
lin AS (
  SELECT user_id, channel, COUNT(*) AS k FROM t GROUP BY user_id, channel
),
credit AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(a.last_ch, 'unattributed') AS channel, pu.amt AS last_amt, 0 AS first_amt, 0 AS lin_amt
  FROM pu LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.user_id = pu.user_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(a.first_ch, 'unattributed'), 0, pu.amt, 0
  FROM pu LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.user_id = pu.user_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.channel, 0, 0, pu.amt * l.k / a.n
  FROM pu JOIN agg a ON a.user_id = pu.user_id JOIN lin l ON l.user_id = pu.user_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'unattributed', 0, 0, pu.amt
  FROM pu WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agg a WHERE a.user_id = pu.user_id)
),
tot AS (
  SELECT channel, SUM(last_amt) AS l, SUM(first_amt) AS f, SUM(lin_amt) AS n FROM credit GROUP BY channel
),
names AS (
  SELECT channel_name AS channel FROM channels
  UNION ALL SELECT 'unattributed'
)
SELECT nm.channel,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t.l, 0), 2) AS last_click_revenue,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t.f, 0), 2) AS first_click_revenue,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t.n, 0), 2) AS linear_revenue,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t.f, 0), 2) - ROUND(COALESCE(t.l, 0), 2) AS first_minus_last_revenue
FROM names nm LEFT JOIN tot t ON t.channel = nm.channel
ORDER BY last_click_revenue DESC, nm.channel ASC
